messages.content:
[1] suggested form אב
Uses:
  1a) אבא = "my father" [Mishnah (Hebrew)] — in: שלא יאמר אדם לחבירו [אבא] גדול מאביך ושלא יהו
  1b) מאביך = "than your father" [Mishnah (Hebrew)] — in: אדם לחבירו אבא גדול [מאביך] ושלא יהו המינים אומרים
  1c) אב = "primary source" — in: חוץ מן המשקה שהוא [אב] הטומאה
Candidates:
  1. אַבָּא I (from the word) — (no English given)
  2. אַבָּא II (from the word) — בָּא, וָוא, וָוה in Y.) pr. n. m. Abba, (Ba, Va), a frequent name. [Sometimes distinguished persons go by that; א׳ אריכא, v. רַב; רב א׳ v. רָבָא; בר בא) א׳ בר אבהו Abba bar Abbahu (Ba), father of Samuel, an Amora. Abba bar Abbahu (Ba), father of Samuel, an; א׳ בר רב הונא, in Bab. רַבָּה q. v; א׳ מרי, contr. אבמרי Abba 
  3. אַבָּא III (from the word) — Abba (father), a title of scholars (less than Rabbi), as Abba Saul, A. Yudan, etc.; cmp. foreg
  4. אִבָּא (from the word) — אבב); thicket, woods, grove; fruit, v. אִיבָּא
  5. אִיבָּא I (from the word) — cmp. אֵב) growth, fruit
  6. אִנְבָּא I (via אִיבָּא I) — = אִיבָּא I, fruit, produce
  7. אִנְבָּא II (via אִיבָּא I) — אִינְבָּא f. (= עִינְבָּא) [berries], eggs of lice, nits. Naz
  8. אַב־ — a prefix of words of Greek origin answering to αὐ-, au-, e.g. אבטומטוס = αὐτόματος; or to εὐ, e.g. אבגינוס = ε
  9. אָב I — Assyr. A-bu, Schr. K. A. T., p
  10. אָב II — const. אֲבִי, אַב [embracer], father, ancestor, progenitor; teacher; chief, leader; author, originator; fathers, ancestors, patriarchs &c; Aboth, the first section of the Prayer of Benedictions (v. תְּפִלָּה), so called because it alludes to the Pat; Aboth, name of a treatise of the Mishnah, containing sayings of Talmu
  11. אָב II ² — ch., v. אַבָּא
  12. אֵב — swelling, spreading, whence; the young shoots of a tree, opp. to the branches growing directly from the trunk; pl. אִבִּין, אִיבִּין state of growth, development
  13. אביך (from the word) — (no English given)

[2] suggested form אבא
Uses:
  2a) אבא = "Abba" — in: פפא כגון פפא בר [אבא]
Candidates:
  1. אַבָּא I (from the word) — (no English given)
  2. אַבָּא II (from the word) — בָּא, וָוא, וָוה in Y.) pr. n. m. Abba, (Ba, Va), a frequent name. [Sometimes distinguished persons go by that; א׳ אריכא, v. רַב; רב א׳ v. רָבָא; בר בא) א׳ בר אבהו Abba bar Abbahu (Ba), father of Samuel, an Amora. Abba bar Abbahu (Ba), father of Samuel, an; א׳ בר רב הונא, in Bab. רַבָּה q. v; א׳ מרי, contr. אבמרי Abba 
  3. אַבָּא III (from the word) — Abba (father), a title of scholars (less than Rabbi), as Abba Saul, A. Yudan, etc.; cmp. foreg
  4. אִבָּא (from the word) — אבב); thicket, woods, grove; fruit, v. אִיבָּא
  5. אִיבָּא I (from the word) — cmp. אֵב) growth, fruit
  6. אִנְבָּא I (via אִיבָּא I) — = אִיבָּא I, fruit, produce
  7. אִנְבָּא II (via אִיבָּא I) — אִינְבָּא f. (= עִינְבָּא) [berries], eggs of lice, nits. Naz

[3] suggested form אבהו
Uses:
  3a) אבהו = "Abbahu" — in: רבי [אבהו] כי הוה אתי ממתיבתא
Candidates:
  1. אַבָּהוּ (from the word) — Abbahu, name of two Palestine Amoraim, one prob. of the first gener

[4] suggested form אבולא
Uses:
  4a) מאבולא = "from the city gate" — in: אמר כגון דחייצי גברי [מאבולא] ועד סיכרא רב ששת
Candidates:
  1. אִבּוּלָא (from the word) — esp. (corresp. to h. מבוא העיר) city gate-way which is opened for wagons &c.; fortified place where judges sit

[5] suggested form אביי
Uses:
  5a) אביי = "Abaye" — in: אמר [אביי] אי סלקא דעתך נבילה
Candidates:
  1. אַבַּיִּי (from the word) — Abbayi; a renowned Babyl. Amora (original name נַחְמֵנִי); Oth. Amoraim of that name
  2. אַבָּיִי (from the word) — v. אַבָּיָיה
  3. אַבָּיָיה (via אַבָּיִי) — contr. of אבעיה; בעי) prayer. בר א׳ reader, precentor

[6] suggested form אבל
Uses:
  6a) אבל = "but" — in: ישלמנה משום דלא שכיחא [אבל] טרפה דשכיחא אימא לא
Candidates:
  1. אֲבָל (from the word) — b. h.); indeed, yes; but, however
  2. אָבֵל I (from the word) — b. h.) pr. n. pl. Abel, name of several towns; cmp. אֲבֵילִין
  3. אָבֵל II (from the word) — v. אבב; cmp. אפל); [dark, cmp. קֹדֵר], mourner, esp. during seven days after burial
  4. אָבֵל III (from the word) — foreg.) to mourn. Hithpa. הִתְאַבֵּל, Nithpa. נִתְאַבֵּל to observe mourning ceremonies, to be bound to mourn,
  5. אֲבֵל (from the word) — Ithpa. denom. of אֲבֵלָא) to mourn
  6. אֵבֶל (from the word) — foreg.) mourning; cmp. אֲבֵילוּת
  7. אֻבָל (from the word) — v. אוּבָל
  8. אוּבָל (via אֻבָל) — v. יוּבָל); river; as a pr. n. Ubal (The River)

[7] suggested form אבן
Uses:
  7a) האבנים = "the stones" [Mishnah (Hebrew)] — in: מושלך על העצים ועל [האבנים]
  7b) באבנים = "with stones" — in: רבנן וכסהו יכול יכסנו [באבנים] או יכפה עליו את
  7c) אבנים = "stones" — in: הדק וחול הדק ושחיקת [אבנים] ושחיקת חרסית ונעורת פשתן
Candidates:
  1. אֶבֶן — v. Ges. H. Dict. s. v.) stone; Compounds and combinations: . Stone Chamber, name of a Temple compartment. Parah III
  2. אֶבֶן ² — (no English given)
  3. אֹבֶן — only in Du. אָבְנַיִם (b. h; the potter’s turning implement; the passage of the embryo, vagina

[8] suggested form אגף
Uses:
  8a) אגפיים = "the sides" — in: אמרו דם הניתז ושעל [אגפיים] חייב לכסות אמר רבן
Candidates:
  1. אָגַף — sec. r. of גְּפַף, v. גּוּף) to fill up a hole with pitch &c
  2. גּוּף I (via אָגַף) — perf. a. part. גָּף (= גָּפַף) [to join body to body,] to squeeze, cork, bung; Pi. to embrace, hug
  3. גּוּף (via אָגַף) — to close; to embrace,] to have illegitimate intercourse, to commit adultery with; Af. אָגֵף to close; Pa. as Pe
  4. גּוּף II (via אָגַף) — body, person, self; essence, substance; membrum; surface, color (cmp. גַּוָּון)
  5. אַגָּף — גּוּף I) the moulding or eminence of the door frame against which the door shuts, door-stop (esp. of door-ways
  6. אֲגַף — com. (v. foreg. = גַּף; cmp. b. h. אֲגַפִּים); wing, pinion. Pl. אֲגַפִּים; Du. אֲגַפַּיִים; winged animals, poultry; arms, shoulders of a human being; banks of river &c

[9] suggested form אגריפס
Uses:
  9a) אגריפס = "Agrippa" — in: ישראל אמרו עליו על [אגריפס] המלך שעבר מלפני כלה
Candidates:
  1. אַגְרִיפַּס (from the word) — Ἀγρίππας) Agrippa; the last but one Herodian king of Judæa

[10] suggested form אדם
Uses:
  10a) אדם = "people" — in: דתניא הכוהו עשרה בני [אדם] בעשר מקלות בין בבת
  10b) אדם = "a person" [Mishnah (Hebrew)] — in: עד מפי עד ומפי [אדם] נאמן שמא אי אתם
  10c) אדם = "Adam, man" [Mishnah (Hebrew)] — in: לפיכך נברא [אדם] יחידי ללמדך שכל המאבד
  10d) שאדם = "that a person" [Mishnah (Hebrew)] — in: של הקדוש ברוך הוא [שאדם] טובע כמה מטבעות בחותם
  10e) אדם = "person" [Mishnah (Hebrew)] — in: ברוך הוא טבע כל [אדם] בחותמו של אדם הראשון
  10f) אדם = "Adam" [Mishnah (Hebrew)] — in: כל אדם בחותמו של [אדם] הראשון ואין אחד מהן
Candidates:
  1. אֲדַם (from the word) — v. הֲדַם. [v. Rabb. D. S. to
  2. אָדַם (from the word) — v. דמם) [to be viscous, thick, dark] to be red, grow red; Pi. to redden, make red; Hif. b. h.) (b. h.) to be, grow red; Hif. to cause to blush, put to shame (usu. הלבין)
  3. אָדָם (from the word) — m. (b. h.) man, pr. n. m. Adam, frequ. א׳ הראשון (abbr. אה"ר)
  4. אֲדָם (from the word) — = דָּם, דְּמָא) blood
  5. הֲדַם (via אֲדַם) — Pa. (אַדֵּם) הַדֵּם; to dissect, dismember, tear to pieces; אֲהַדֵּם (denom. of next w.) to arrange the parts of an animal
  6. הַדָּם (via אֲדַם) — v. preced.) part, member.—Pl. הַדָּמִין, הַדָּמֵי
  7. חוּל (via אֲדָם) — to turn around, circle; to dance. Part. חָל, חוֹל; perf. חָל; cmp. חַג) to come in turn, to occur; with על) to hover around one’s head, to rest upon one as a duty; to take effect (as a law); Hof. to be made to circle,] to be commenced, established
  8. חוּל ² (via אֲדָם) — to dance. Part. חָיֵיל; to take effect. Yoma; to hover over one’s head, be impending; Ithpa. to turn in a circle, dance
  9. חוּל II (via אֲדָם) — v. חָלָה) to be smooth, quiet, v. infra; Hithpol. to be quieted
  10. חוּל ³ (via אֲדָם) — to be smooth, lax; to be forgiving, renounce; to be sweet; Pa. to sweeten (by adding good wine), to improve; Af. אַחֲלֵי, fr. חלי) to be liberal, to forgive
  11. חוֹל I (via אֲדָם) — sand, sand-region, esp. the sand used for glass-making
  12. חוֹל II (via אֲדָם) — Ḥol, name of a fabulous bird (Phoenix)

[11] suggested form או
Uses:
  11a) או = "or" — in: לניזק אתה אומר לניזק [או] אינו אלא למזיק אמרת
Candidates:
  1. אוֹ I (from the word) — v. Ges. H. Dict. s. v.) or; או … או either … or
  2. אוֹ (from the word) — (no English given)
  3. אוֹ II (from the word) — ὁ) the
  4. או־ — prefix, esp. for verbal nouns, e.g; או, אוו = εὐ-αὐ, v. אב
  5. אַב־ (via או־) — a prefix of words of Greek origin answering to αὐ-, au-, e.g. אבטומטוס = αὐτόματος; or to εὐ, e.g. אבגינוס = ε
  6. אָב I (via או־) — Assyr. A-bu, Schr. K. A. T., p
  7. אָב II (via או־) — const. אֲבִי, אַב [embracer], father, ancestor, progenitor; teacher; chief, leader; author, originator; fathers, ancestors, patriarchs &c; Aboth, the first section of the Prayer of Benedictions (v. תְּפִלָּה), so called because it alludes to the Pat; Aboth, name of a treatise of the Mishnah, containing sayings of Talmu
  8. אָב II ² (via או־) — ch., v. אַבָּא
  9. אֵב (via או־) — swelling, spreading, whence; the young shoots of a tree, opp. to the branches growing directly from the trunk; pl. אִבִּין, אִיבִּין state of growth, development
  10. דִּילְמָא (via אוֹ) — = דִּי לְמָא, v. Ezra VII; lest, perhaps; without the meaning of apprehension) perhaps, it may be
  11. דִּילְמָא ² (via אוֹ) — = דָּא (הִיא) אַלְמָא, v. אַלְמָא) here is a confirmation, a heading used in the Palest. dialect for introduci
  12. דילמא (via אוֹ) — (no English given)

[12] suggested form אומד
Uses:
  12a) מאומד = "from conjecture" [Mishnah (Hebrew)] — in: ומאיימין עליהן שמא תאמרו [מאומד] ומשמועה עד מפי עד
Candidates:
  1. אוּמָד (from the word) — אָמַד) estimate, guess, measuring by mere sight, approximate assessment; medical opinion as to the nature of i

[13] suggested form אומה
Uses:
  13a) דאומתיה = "of his nation" — in: הכי רבא דעמיה ומדברנא [דאומתיה] בוצינא דנהורא בריך מתייך
Candidates:
  1. אוּמָּה — v. אֵם) people, nation, government

[14] suggested form אור
Uses:
  14a) קמיירי = "is it speaking" — in: בקטלא לא [קמיירי]
Candidates:
  1. אוֹר I — to perforate, break through, shine.—Denom. אַוִּיר, מְאוּרָה &c; Nif. to be broken through, grow light; Hif. neut. v.) (neut. v.) to break through, shine; Hif. act. v.) to enlighten, brighten, make shine
  2. אוֹר — Part. pass. נָאוֹר clear
  3. חָוַר (via אוֹר) — to perforate; to be transparent, white, clear; Pi. to make clear, evident; Hithpa. to be made clear
  4. חֲוַר (via אוֹר) — to be white, to shine; of eyes) to be bright, to look with gratification; Pa. to whiten, wash, cleanse; Pa. to make evident, to prove; Af. to make white
  5. חָוַּר (via אוֹר) — v. חִיוַּר
  6. חוּר I (via אוֹר) — cmp. preced. wds.) to bore
  7. חוֹר I (via אוֹר) — preced. wds.); hole, cavity; ant’s store, v. חוֹרָר
  8. חוֹר II (via אוֹר) — b. h.), pl. חוֹרִין [white garments,] freedom; בֶּן ח׳, בַּת ח׳ free, freed, opp. to slave
  9. חוּר III (via אוֹר) — b. h.) pr. n. m. Hur, the husband of Miriam
  10. אוֹר II — foreg.) breaking forth (cmp; break of day, light, day; fire; trnsf. rise, glory, power, happiness; breaking in of night) twilight, evening; homil. = אוֹרָה II) rue
  11. אוּר I — foreg.) prop. light, flame; esp. Pl. אוּרִים ותומים the Urim and Tummim in the High-priest’s breast-plate. Yom
  12. *אוּר II — = עוּר q. v.) chaff

[15] suggested form אזל
Uses:
  15a) אזלא = "it would spread" — in: אי דבלאו איהו לא [אזלא] פשיטא אלא דבלאו איהו
Candidates:
  1. אֲזַל I — to be gone, to leave; to go
  2. אֲזַל II — = עזל; v. Ezek. XXVII
  3. זוּל I (via אֲזַל II) — v. זָלַל) to be of slight value, to be cheap; to be despicable, mean; low, mean; spendthrift, glutton. Sifré; Hif. to become cheap, fall in price; Hif. to treat with contempt. Treat. Der. Er. ch. II מְזִילֵי הרבים those who treat the public &c; Hof. to fall in price
  4. זוּל (via אֲזַל II) — perf. זָל, Part. זִיל, זוֹל; to disregard; to be worthless, cheap; Af. to sell cheap, make easy terms; Ithpe. to be degraded, disgraced
  5. זוּל II (via אֲזַל II) — cmp. אֲזַל II) to spin
  6. זוֹל (via אֲזַל II) — זוּל I) low price
  7. אַזְלוֹיָא (via אֲזַל II) — foreg.) weaver. Pl. אַזְלוֹיֵי

[16] suggested form אח
Uses:
  16a) אחיו = "his brother" [Mishnah (Hebrew)] — in: מצינו בקין שהרג את [אחיו] שנאמר דמי אחיך צעקים
  16b) אחיך = "your brother" [Mishnah (Hebrew)] — in: את אחיו שנאמר דמי [אחיך] צעקים אינו אומר דם
Candidates:
  1. אָח I — brother, kinsman; fellow, equal, fellow-believer &c
  2. אַח — (no English given)
  3. אָח II — interj. interj; b. h.) exclamation of sorrow, Oh!
  4. אֲחִיךְ (from the word) — to laugh, v. חוּךְ
  5. חוֹךְ (via אֲחִיךְ) — to rub, scratch, v. חָכַךְ
  6. חוּךְ I (via אֲחִיךְ) — (no English given)
  7. חוּךְ II (via אֲחִיךְ) — onomatop., v. preced.) [to hawk,] to laugh, (= צָחַק) to jest with, caress; to laugh at. Part. חָאִיךְ, חָיֵיך; Pa. same; Pa. to hawk; Pa. to laugh; Af. same
  8. חוֹךְ I (via אֲחִיךְ) — scab, v. חִיכּוּךְ
  9. חוֹךְ II (via אֲחִיךְ) — חוּךְ II) laughter, gladness, object of derision

[17] suggested form אחא
Uses:
  17a) אחא = "Acha" — in: הני מילי אמר רבי [אחא] בר חנינא דאמר קרא
Candidates:
  1. אַחָא (from the word) — brother; v. אַח; pr. n. m. Aḥa

[18] suggested form אחד
Uses:
  18a) אחד = "one" — in: חמשה שישבו על ספסל [אחד] ולא שברוהו ובא אחד
  18b) ואחד = "and one" — in: יושבין לפניהן כל אחד [ואחד] מכיר את מקומו הוצרכו
Candidates:
  1. אֶחָד (from the word) — אַחַת f. (b. h.; v. next w., one. [Freq. represented by א׳; singular, unique; cmp. אֲחַד) closed up, mysterious
  2. אָחַד (from the word) — sec. r. of חוּד, v. חוּד I) to join, close. Part. pass. אָחוּד, pl. אֲחוּדִים; closed up, mysterious; joined, united
  3. אֲחַד (from the word) — Pa. אָחֵיד, אַחֵד ch. (v. foreg.); corresp. to h. סגר a. תפש; cmp. h. אחז) to close (the door), to lock up; to seize, capture; to devote, v. אֲחִיד; Af. to seize; Ithpe. to be seized; Ithpe. to be locked up, joined

[19] suggested form אחר
Uses:
  19a) אחר = "after" — in: בבת אחת בין בזה [אחר] זה ומת כולן פטורין
  19b) אחר = "another" [Mishnah (Hebrew)] — in: דמו ודם זרעיותיו דבר [אחר] דמי אחיך שהיה דמו
Candidates:
  1. אָחַר (from the word) — to be behind, v. Pi; euphem.) to cover (of camels); Pi. to tarry, hesitate; to set behind; Pu. to be postponed, be done late, be placed later
  2. אֲחַר (from the word) — to be behind; *to cover; Pa. take ye a later meal (on Sabbaths); Af. same; *Ithpe. contr. אִתְחַר to be delayed
  3. אַחַר (from the word) — v. foreg.), pl. constr. אַחֲרֵי after, behind; conj. followed by ש־ or ד־) after, since, whereas, because; a legal term, meaḥar, the presumption of the truth of one’s statement, because he might have pleaded more prof
